zcode.strict_binding_status: UNAVAILABLE by design: scripts/zcode_appserver_bridge.py rejects strict_binding. The installed bridge correlates session/input/turn and terminal completion but does not authenticate principal/account. Official ZCode docs assign identity/provider resolution to the Desktop Host; the Agent process is not the identity authority, and secrets are not included in conversation snapshots. A future Strict adapter needs a host-owned non-secret identity binding and trusted review-proof callback, not model output, environment labels, or exposed credentials.
